definitions.explanation: A brief meeting held at the start of the workday or school day for announcements, coordination, and team alignment.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{朝会|ちょうかい}がある。
examples.english: There is a morning meeting every day.

examples.japanese: {朝会|ちょうかい}で{今日|きょう}の{予定|よてい}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: We confirm today's schedule at the morning meeting.

examples.japanese: {校長|こうちょう}{先生|せんせい}が{朝会|ちょうかい}で{全校生徒|ぜんこうせいと}に{話|はなし}をした。
examples.english: The principal spoke to all the students at the morning assembly.

notes:
Used in both school and workplace settings. In schools, {朝会|ちょうかい} (also called {全校朝会|ぜんこうちょうかい}) is a regular assembly where the principal addresses students. In companies, it refers to a short daily stand-up meeting at the start of work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {朝会|ちょうかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a morning meeting
- {全校|ぜんこう}{朝会|ちょうかい}: schoolwide morning assembly
- {朝会|ちょうかい}で{発表|はっぴょう}する: to make an announcement at the morning meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝礼|ちょうれい}: morning assembly — very similar; {朝礼|ちょうれい} is more commonly used in corporate settings and may include a more formal structure
- {終礼|しゅうれい}: end-of-day meeting — the counterpart held at the end of the workday
- ミーティング: meeting — a general loanword for any kind of meeting
